verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.bentolabs.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content, and docs pages are served as agent-readable .md files. Bento also ships an agent-oriented path: a paste-in prompt for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf installs Agent Skills with the full integration playbook and loads the docs over MCP. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents actually work well with these docs (e.g., an llms-full.txt or real-world agent usage reports).
